review_method: Recovered the durable Wan image-to-video job without resubmission; ffprobe and a five-frame, one-second contact sheet were compared with the exact s11 inertia narration cue.

shots.observation: The child and bicycle are coherent and move, but the sampled frames do not make a wheel stop followed by forward body motion unambiguous. The last frame changes posture abruptly. This is not sufficient proof of the physical claim.
shots.use_policy: Do not use as the explanatory s11 shot. A brief generic bicycle context cue is possible only if paired with separate verified deterministic stop/forward-motion teaching animation.
